When shooting that enemy unit, those ranged attacks have -1 to hit rolls (excluding [Close-quarters] attacks). When that enemy unit is selected to make a fall-back move, if that enemy unit is only engaged with FORTIFICATION units, and that enemy unit is not battle-shocked, hazard rolls made for that enemy unit are automatically passed.
When an attack targets a unit that is not fully visible to the attacking model because of this unit, the target has the benefit of cover against that attack.

wargearOptions.text: This model can be equipped with up to 3 Big Shootas.

equipped: This model is equipped with: 1 Big Shoota; 1 Gaze of Gork.

transport.en: This model has a transport capacity of 11 ORKS INFANTRY models. It cannot transport GHAZGHKULL THRAKA models. Each MEGA ARMOUR/JUMP PACK model takes up the space of 2 models.
